name: Open Refrigerator
description: Pull open the refrigerator door to inspect its contents.
successMessage: You pull open the fridge door. A wave of cool air pours out over your hands.

name: Close Refrigerator
description: Push the refrigerator door closed with a reassuring magnetic seal.
successMessage: You gently nudge the fridge door shut until the rubber seal clicks tight.

name: Ignite Gas Stove
description: Twist the burner knob and click the gas lighter to start a flame.
successMessage: Click-click-whoosh! A clean ring of blue flame bursts to life on the burner.

name: Turn Off Gas Stove
description: Turn off the burner completely.
successMessage: You switch off the stove knob. The blue flame vanishes instantly.

name: Turn On Bedside Lamp
description: Click the switch on the bedside brass lamp.
successMessage: Click. The bedside lamp fills the bedroom with a mellow golden glow.

name: Turn Off Bedside Lamp
description: Switch off the bedside lamp.
successMessage: Click. The warm light fades and the room settles into shadows.

name: Power On Computer
description: Press the power button on the desktop tower.
successMessage: The PC fans whir up, and the monitors illuminate in crisp high definition.

name: Shut Down Computer
description: Select Shut Down and wait for the monitors to power off.
successMessage: You safely shut down the system. The monitors blink off and quiet returns.

name: Open Wardrobe
description: Swing open the wardrobe doors.
successMessage: The wooden doors creak softly open, revealing your organized clothes.

name: Close Wardrobe
description: Shut the wardrobe doors.
successMessage: You swing the wardrobe doors shut.

name: Fill Glass with Water
description: Hold the glass under the kitchen tap or water filter and fill it up.
successMessage: Cool, filtered water pours cleanly into the tumbler until it is full.

name: Drink Water from Glass
description: Take a long, refreshing drink from the water glass.
successMessage: Ah! You drink the cool water. Your throat feels completely refreshed.

name: Drink from Copper Flask
description: Uncap the copper flask and take a swig of naturally ionized water.
successMessage: You take a satisfying drink from the copper bottle. Crisp and thirst-quenching.

name: Flush Toilet
description: Press the chrome dual-flush button on the toilet cistern.
successMessage: Whoosh! A strong swirl of clean water flushes through the bowl.

name: Look in Mirror
description: Examine your face, hair, and expression in the bathroom mirror.
successMessage: You check yourself in the glass. Eyes clear, hair neat, looking ready for the day.

name: Turn On Kitchen Tap
description: Turn the lever faucet on the sink.
successMessage: Water rushes steadily into the stainless sink basin.

name: Turn Off Kitchen Tap
description: Turn off the faucet completely.
successMessage: You shut off the tap with a smooth turn. Not a single drip.

name: Pick Up Item
description: Hold the portable item in your hands.
successMessage: You pick up the item and hold it safely.

name: Pick Math Textbook
description: Take the mathematics textbook down from the shelf and hold it.
successMessage: You lift the math textbook from the shelf and hold it carefully.

name: Pick Physics Textbook
description: Take the physics textbook down from the shelf and hold it.
successMessage: You pull the physics textbook off the shelf and carry it in your hands.

name: Pick Chemistry Textbook
description: Take the chemistry textbook down from the shelf and hold it.
successMessage: You take the chemistry textbook off the shelf and cradle it in your hands.

name: Pick Psychology Book
description: Take the psychology book off the shelf and hold it.
successMessage: You pick the psychology book from the shelf and carry it with you.

name: Pick Mohit's Notebook
description: Take Mohit's notebook from the shelf and hold it.
successMessage: You pick up Mohit's notebook and hold it carefully in your hands.

name: Pick Aria's Notebook
description: Take Aria's notebook from the shelf and hold it.
successMessage: You take Aria's notebook off the shelf and hold it gently.

name: Put Down Item
description: Set down the held item onto a nearby surface.
successMessage: You place the item down neatly.

name: Make the Bed
description: Straighten the bedsheet, pull corners taut, and fluff up the pillows.
successMessage: You smooth out all wrinkles and tuck in the corners. The bed looks crisp and hotel-neat.

name: Wipe Kitchen Counter
description: Dampen a soft microfiber cloth and wipe down the black granite countertop.
successMessage: The black granite gleams smoothly in the morning light, spotless and pristine.

name: Sip Water
description: Take a quick sip of water from the glass.
successMessage: A cool sip wets your mouth and eases your thirst.

name: Sip from Flask
description: Take a quick sip from the copper flask.
successMessage: A refreshing sip from the flask takes the edge off your thirst.

name: Browse the Bookshelf
description: Look over the textbooks and notebooks on the shelf.
successMessage: You scan the shelf, spotting math, physics, chemistry, psychology, and two familiar notebooks.

name: Browse the Web
description: Browse websites and read a few interesting articles.
successMessage: A few interesting pages later, you have learned something new.

name: See Photos
description: Open the photo gallery and look through saved pictures.
successMessage: You scroll through a few familiar photos and pause on a favorite.

name: Take a Selfie
description: Use the webcam to take a quick selfie.
successMessage: The webcam captures a quick photo.

name: Record a Video
description: Record a short video with the computer's webcam.
successMessage: You record a short clip and save it to the computer.

name: Turn On Light
description: Switch on the light in this room.
successMessage: The room light comes on.

name: Turn Off Light
description: Switch off the light in this room.
successMessage: The light goes off.

name: Take a Snack
description: Take a small snack from the open refrigerator.
successMessage: You grab a small snack from the fridge.

name: Take a Cold Drink
description: Take a chilled drink from the open refrigerator.
successMessage: A cold drink quickly refreshes you.

name: Prepare a Snack
description: Arrange a quick snack on the counter.
successMessage: You prepare a small snack on the counter.

name: Wash Hands
description: Wash your hands at the kitchen sink.
successMessage: You wash your hands under cool running water.

name: Wash the Dishes
description: Wash a few dishes in the sink.
successMessage: You wash the dishes until they are clean and stacked to dry.

name: Tidy the Desk
description: Put papers and stationery back in their places.
successMessage: You straighten the desk and clear a little space to work.

name: Check Phone
description: Pick up your phone and check for the time or new messages.
successMessage: You glance over your notifications and the time.

name: Turn On Shower
description: Turn on the shower and adjust the water temperature.
successMessage: Warm water begins to flow from the shower.

name: Turn Off Shower
description: Turn off the running shower.
successMessage: You turn off the shower and the water settles to a drip.
